subject: Request: Commercial exception — extended eval + complimentary credits for Catalyx Health
messages:
From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: commercial exception — extended eval + complimentary credits for Catalyx Health

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Quick summary: Catalyx Health is a mid-market health-tech company evaluating Redwood for clinical note generation and embeddings over the last 3 weeks. They moved fast in PLG but burned through the default trial credits due to larger-than-usual ingestion and evaluation runs tied to EHR synthetic datasets. Key points:
- Account: Catalyx Health (Anika Rao, Head of ML)
- Use case: clinical summarization + search, expecting 1–2M tokens/day in PoC peak
- Current status: They signaled interest to convert to Dedicated if latency / cost looks good, but procurement needs more runway to finish security review and SOC-2 evidence piece.

Ask: I’m requesting an exception to our standard PLG limits — extend the eval window by 45 days and provide $50k in complimentary credits to keep them running through procurement. The seller case: this account is likely to convert to Dedicated within 3 months with an estimated $120k ARR in year one.

Attachments: catalyx_eval_usage_summary.csv (usage by day), plus I’ve drafted a short mutual action plan (will send if we greenlight).

Can you review and advise whether this needs CRO signoff or if Deal Desk can approve? I can provide contract anchors and a committed go-live milestone.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: commercial exception — extended eval + complimentary credits for Catalyx Health

Jordan,

Thanks for the context — read the usage CSV and that spike is real. A few quick Qs before formal escalation:
1) Do we have a written procurement timeline from Catalyx (target PO date)?
2) Any regulatory constraints that prevent us from offering credits (healthcare sector sometimes needs special legal review)?
3) Can you confirm the estimated ARR / conversion probability so we can model ROI?

Recommendation: Given size and vertical, this looks like a case for a senior approval (CRO or Head of Sales). Deal Desk has a $20k complimentary credit band + 30-day extensions we can approve without exec signoff. Your ask is outside Deal Desk bounds so please escalate with a short MAP and a conversion commitment (preferred).

If you want, I can draft the Deal Desk memo.

—Marissa
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Aditya, Rishi — escalating per Marissa's rec. I’ve included the quick MAP and anchor terms below. Catalyx is on a hard procurement timeline tied to a board review on 1/6/27. If we cannot keep their evaluation running through the review, they will pause everything and the momentum will be lost.

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Today: Extend eval environment access for integration team; provide logs + SOC-2 artifact window
- Week 1–3: Performance tuning + small-scale A/B prompts with our optimization team
- Week 4–6: Quantify cost/latency for Dedicated; finalize POC acceptance criteria
- By 2027-01-10: Catalyx to sign PO for Dedicated / commit to a 12-month contract at negotiated rate

Specific ask: 45-day extension + $50,000 in complimentary credits (token credit) to be applied only to the eval org (non-production) and not transferable. As part of approval, I’m proposing two guardrails:
1) We require a conversion checkpoint call (Sales + CTO + Catalyx) at 30 days to confirm progress.
2) If Catalyx fails to provide PO by 2027-01-10, remaining credits are revoked.

Rationale: High conversion probability (~55% per my forecast), strategic in healthcare vertical, and opening door to Dedicated deployment in US region.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_Catalyx_v2.pdf (MAP + acceptance criteria)

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Jordan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: commercial exception — extended eval + complimentary credits for Catalyx Health

Jordan, Aditya, Marissa — thanks for the clear ask and MAP. I reviewed the Deal Desk memo and the usage patterns. I agree Catalyx is strategically compelling. Approving a partial concession with conditions:

Decision: Approve a 30-day extension and $30,000 in complimentary eval credits applied to the eval org (non-production).

Conditions:
- Sales to secure a signed LOI or signed commercial term sheet by 2026-12-20 confirming intent to purchase Dedicated if acceptance criteria met.
- Schedule a Milestone Review meeting on 2026-12-22 (Sales + Catalyx CTO + Redwood Solutions Engineer) to validate progress.
- Legal to confirm no unusual transfer/harvest risk and add a one-time rollback clause in the credit addendum (handled by Legal Ops).

If the LOI is not in hand by 12/20, credits are rescinded and accounts will be disabled for the eval org. If the LOI is signed earlier and acceptance criteria are met, we will convert the remaining potential credits into an invoice credit applied to the first Dedicated invoice.

Jordan — please confirm you will secure the LOI and schedule the 12/22 review. Marissa — please update Deal Desk record and prepare the credit addendum for Legal Ops.

—Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
